in_sanskrit.name: नीयती
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: प्रियतरा - प्रिया (beloved) + तरा (one who crosses, or reaches) - प्रियतरा (one who reaches or is dear to many)

in_hindi.name: नीयती
in_hindi.long_meaning: प्रियतरा - प्रिया (प्रिय) + तरा (तराना - प्राप्यते, reaching) - प्रियतरा (प्रिय तथा अनेक जीवें को प्राप्य करने वाला, one who is dear to many)

in_tamil.name: நீயாதி
in_tamil.long_meaning: அங்கிழமையால் - அன்னையால் (dear to many) + திரும்பப்பட்ட - அங்கிழமையால் திரும்பப்பட்ட ஒன்று (one who is dear to many)

in_telugu.name: నీయాది
in_telugu.long_meaning: ప్రియమైయేదు - ప్రియము (beloved) + ఈదు (ఇదే, exists, is) - ప్రియమైయేదు (one who exists as the beloved of many)

in_marathi.name: Neeyati
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neeyati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Neeyati is derived from the Sanskrit word 'neeyat', meaning 'graceful', 'attractive', or 'alluring'. In Hindu mythology, Neeyati is a name for the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, prosperity, and beauty.
